name: Shanghai Bao Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Bao Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. is a biotechnology company that researches, develops and commercialises pharmaceutical products in mainland China. It uses synthetic biology to develop recombinant biologic drugs, including KJ017, a recombinant human hyaluronidase for subcutaneous drug delivery, and KJ103, an IgG-degrading enzyme for IgG-mediated autoimmune diseases.
